Question Choices: A baker uses 4/9 cups of sugar for each cake. He bakes 9 cakes. How many cups of sugar does he use in total? (Answer with a whole number)
Hints: Multiply the whole number by the numerator; keep the denominator. Simplify or regroup into the requested form.
Solution: 9 equal groups of 4/9 give (9 x 4)/9 = 36/9. The denominator stays 9 because each part has size 1/9. In the requested form: 4. Check: 4 / 9 = 4/9.

Question Choices: Emma runs 3/4 of a mile every day for 6 days. How many miles does she run in total? (Answer as a mixed number)
Hints: Multiply the whole number by the numerator; keep the denominator. Simplify or regroup into the requested form.
Solution: 6 equal groups of 3/4 give (6 x 3)/4 = 18/4. The denominator stays 4 because each part has size 1/4. In the requested form: 4 1/2. Check: 9/2 / 6 = 3/4.

Question Choices: Each of 5 puppies eats 2 1/6 cups of food. How many cups do the 5 puppies eat in total? Give the answer as a mixed number.
Hints: Each puppy eats the same amount. Multiply the whole-number part and the fraction part by the number of puppies, then add.
Solution: There are 5 equal servings of 2 1/6 cups. Multiply the whole part: 5 x 2 = 10 cups. Multiply the fraction part: 5 x 1/6 = 5/6 cup. Add the parts: 10 + 5/6 = 10 5/6 cups in total.

Question Choices: Amy, who is an athlete, completes a lap in 3/5 of a minute. How long does it take her to run 10 laps? (Answer as a mixed number or whole number)
Hints: Multiply the whole number by the numerator; keep the denominator. Simplify or regroup into the requested form.
Solution: 10 equal groups of 3/5 give (10 x 3)/5 = 30/5. The denominator stays 5 because each part has size 1/5. In the requested form: 6. Check: 6 / 10 = 3/5.

Solution: 8 equal groups of 3/7 give (8 x 3)/7 = 24/7. The denominator stays 7 because each part has size 1/7. In the requested form: 3 3/7. Check: 24/7 / 8 = 3/7.
